target_gates: For each stock target, the R27 forced twin has exactly one attributable rise inside the unchanged 270 ms event window and the authentic no-force twin has no rise.
Report perturbed-mechanics target results without changing selection or parameters.
No target slot has duplicate rises, pre-force alarm, outside-window false rise, or stuck tail.
Every injected force and causal pre-force prefix is exact; R26 and R27 physical traces are exact.
preservation_gates: Detected comparator remains strict with no extra rise and no first-rise delay or active-duration increase versus frozen R26.
All 32 force-free normal fit/audit episodes remain candidate-rise-free.
The extra pulse never holds output when the native R26 report is live; pending extra evidence is cancelled by native output.
Disclosed pregrasp actual-tool controls old_xy and old_xyz, and legacy distinct inputs, are evaluated only after the fixed known-case panel and must not lose an R26 rise.
falsifiers: Either stock target remains without an attributable R27 rise.
Any new no-force rise, duplicate target/comparator rise, native detection loss, or physical/force/prefix mismatch.
Any source/model/protocol change after this lock.
stop: If falsified, retain the exact failure and do not tune this candidate on forced outcomes.
